_comment: Clarity in the Quran (@ClarityInTheQuran, UC0eBu0ZXcF20pTAG3lUnPXA) packaging fix, 2026-08-17. Built from clarity/channel-diagnosis.md. Applied by automation/clarity_packaging.py.
_expect_channel_id: Enforced before any write: the script resolves the authenticated channel with mine=true and aborts unless it equals this. Three channels share this repo and one wrong token silently repackages the wrong one.
_tags_provenance: IMPORTANT — these tags were WRITTEN, not harvested. The diagnosis first claimed the 'RELATED SEARCHES' paragraph in each description could simply be moved into the tags field. Testing that on the real descriptions disproved it: those paragraphs are flowing prose, so a mechanical extract yields fragments like 'this video was made for you', 'this study goes deep into all of it' and 'or is it allowed to be rich in Islam', and QNlRJcyY4LU yields nothing at all. Bad tags are worse than none — they spend the 500-char field on noise. Each list below is hand-written from the video's actual subject, using the harvested phrases only as raw material.
_tag_budget: YouTube caps the entire tags field at 500 characters and rejects the whole update with `invalidTags` past it. A tag containing a space is sent quoted, costing two extra characters. clarity_packaging.py budgets 460 and drops overflow rather than failing the write.
_set_packaging: Freshly published uploads only. Title+description+tags land in ONE write per video because videos.list is read-after-write eventually consistent. Every id in `protected` is refused. Added 2026-08-22.

set_packaging._why: The 21 Aug upload — 7h old, 3 views, ZERO tags. Not settled: nothing to disturb.
_changes: TAGS 0 -> 22. This is the regression. A pass on 17 Aug took the channel from 11 untagged uploads to 0; the very next upload shipped untagged again, because no workflow existed to run the fix. clarity-packaging.yml now exists.

TITLE. The old one carried 'Ayah' with a macron (U+0100) — a token nobody types, so the only distinctive word in the title was unsearchable — and named no surah, no verse and no subject. YouTube had no entity to classify it against. The new title front-loads the exact English phrase people search ('hearts find rest'), names Surah Ar-Ra'd 28, and keeps the 'you have only seen half' hook. 62 chars, so nothing truncates.

TITLE SHAPE matches the channel's own proven construction — '[Entity]: [the specific thing you are missing]' — which is 3 of its 4 best videos (Money in the Quran 225, Every Minor Prophet 192, Every Plague of Egypt 189).

DESCRIPTION opening rewritten. The first two lines are the search snippet and carried zero ASCII-searchable terms ('The ayah people put on their wall lives inside a surah named after the loudest thing in the sky'). They now lead with the full quoted verse, 'Surah Ar-Ra'd 28' and 'Quran 13:28'. The author's diacritics are kept in the body — they are the channel's credibility signal after the 'AI BE AWARE' comment — but every surah name now also appears in plain ASCII with its numeric citation.
HASHTAGS 20 -> 5. The same 10-hashtag block was pasted twice. YouTube ignores ALL hashtags on a video once there are more than 15, so the video was running with zero working hashtags.
SOURCING NOTE restored. The 16 Aug upload set the channel's standard with 'Arabic on screen is set from a verified mushaf' plus a no-ruling disclaimer; this upload dropped both. Re-added.

set_packaging.title: "Hearts Find Rest": The Half of Surah Ar-Ra'd 28 Nobody Quotes
set_packaging.description:
"Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest." Surah Ar-Ra'd 28 — Quran 13:28 — is the ayah people put on their wall. Almost nobody reads the sentence standing in front of it.

And the Arabic underneath "hearts find rest" is doing something far more physical than the English lets on. Ṭumaʾnīnah — tumaninah — does not mean peace, and it does not mean calm. Its root sense is to settle: to sink down and come to rest, the way silt drops out of stirred water, the way ground finishes moving. It is the same word the Prophet ﷺ used to correct a man's prayer — bow until you are settled. A prayer without it is not a prayer.

This is a slow walk through Surah Ar-Ra'd (13), "The Thunder", verses 27-28: where the line sits, what the sentence before it does to it, why the second half is the half that matters, and where the same root turns up at the very end of the Quran as something other than a verb.

CHAPTERS
0:00 The surah named after thunder
1:03 Tumaninah — what the word pictures
2:14 It is a requirement inside the prayer
3:16 What we are walking toward
4:07 The sentence nobody quotes
5:56 The same word, said of the wrong thing
6:43 Who the ayah is describing
7:49 Sakinah — it is sent down
9:00 Dhikr has a tongue in it
9:54 Settled is not numb
11:41 The silt
13:12 The cave
14:29 On an ordinary bad day
16:48 O settled soul

VERSES REFERENCED
Surah Ar-Ra'd 12, 13, 27, 28 (13:12-13, 13:27-28) · Surah Yunus 7 (10:7) · Surah Al-Fath 4 (48:4) · Surah Al-Hijr 9 (15:9) · Surah Yusuf 86 (12:86) · Surah Al-Qasas 10 (28:10) · Surah At-Tawbah 40 (9:40) · Surah Al-Fajr 27 (89:27) · and the hadith of the man who prayed badly (Bukhari and Muslim).

ON THE DISAGREEMENT AT 6:43
The mufassirūn are not of one mind on whether ayah 28 continues the sentence before it or stands on its own. Both readings are presented, because both land in the same place.

HOW THIS VIDEO IS MADE
The Arabic on screen is set from a verified mushaf. This is a study of language and tafsir — it issues no ruling.

If this gave you something, subscribe — and tell me in the comments what your heart is currently trying to settle onto. Even one word.

channel._why: youtube_channel_about returned keywords: [] — the channel has no channel-level keywords at all. Weak signal alone, but it is one of the few inputs YouTube uses to place a channel in a topic cluster, and empty gives it nothing. Costs nothing, cannibalises nothing. Same free win taken on channel 2.

protected._why: Never repackage a proven winner. These four carry 1,452 of the channel's 2,473 lifetime views. Their TITLES and DESCRIPTION BODIES must not move — retitling a settled video measured +0 views over 21.7 hours on channel 1, and that finding is about how YouTube treats settled videos rather than about any channel's subject. Adding tags to them is safe and additive; the one description edit above is a defect repair on a specific line, not a rewrite.

deferred._why: Named here so they are not silently dropped. Each needs a human decision or content this repo does not have.
